name: Epic SixSixSix

features.name: Wicked Wheels
features.description: 6 symbols on reels 1, 3 or 5 spin wheels that award multipliers, extra wheels or the max win.

features.name: Gamble or free spins
features.description: 3 or 4 FS symbols let you gamble the bonus or take 10 spins with blue or all-red wheels.

features.name: Epic Bonus
features.description: 5 FS award 10 free spins where a red Wicked Wheel lands on every spin.

review:
SixSixSix with a higher ceiling. Blue or red 6s on reels one, three or five spin Wicked Wheels that can give multipliers, multiply existing ones, add another 6 (blue wheels), or land on the max win slice. Red wheels carry the bigger numbers.

Three FS symbols offer a gamble or 10 spins full of wheels; four offer a gamble or 10 spins of only red wheels; five start the Epic Bonus with a red wheel every spin. Rated 5/5, 20,666x max, RTP versions of 96%, 94% and 92%. For experienced high-volatility players.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 92.00% RTP
Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
